doc: The same function on a float32 array: the Python float edges stay weak, so the whole chain is float32 and the result float32. The tiles code never passes float32; the case pins the dtype rule. Tolerance 1e-5 relative / 1e-6 absolute (float32 kernel of a few operations; the same computation in float64 differs by 1.4e-7 absolute, 4.6e-7 relative).
